SAVINGS_AMOUNT.formula: CASE WHEN MY_PROMOTED_PRICE > 0 AND MY_PROMOTED_PRICE < REGULAR_PRICE THEN (REGULAR_PRICE - MY_PROMOTED_PRICE) * UPLIFT_VOLUME ELSE 0 END

PLANNED_FIXED_SPEND_AMOUNT.formula: COALESCE(FIXED_AD_FEES, 0) + COALESCE(FIXED_DISPLAY_FEES, 0) + COALESCE(FIXED_MARKDOWN_FEES, 0) + COALESCE(FIXED_MISC, 0) + COALESCE(SLOTTING_FIXED, 0) + COALESCE(FIXED_COUPON_CLEARING_HOUSE, 0) + COALESCE(FIXED_NON_COUPON_CLEARING_HOUSE, 0) + COALESCE(FIXED_PROGRAM_COST, 0)

SALE_DURATION_DAYS.formula: CASE WHEN RETAILER_START_DATE_WEEKLY IS NOT NULL AND RETAILER_END_DATE_WEEKLY IS NOT NULL THEN DATEDIFF(RETAILER_END_DATE_WEEKLY, RETAILER_START_DATE_WEEKLY) + 1 ELSE NULL END
